messages:
Anna (product): Quick sync — we need a concrete acceptance checklist for the Private/Dedicated beta cohort. thinking of 4 launch gates: security, perf, onboarding, quality. want input on measurable thresholds and who signs off.
Raj (eng): +1. For perf, suggest p50 token latency < 80ms, p95 < 250ms on typical seq=512 workload. Also throughput: sustained 100 concurrent sessions per node (for the target GPU size).
Emily (design): For onboarding, measure time-to-first-successful-call for partners. target: < 1 hour for 80% of seats (includes env setup + test prompt). capture where they get stuck.
Omar (cs): From support side, require at least 3 partners complete the onboarding with no engineering hand-hold (self-serve) and we log top 5 friction points. Also need a runbook for rollback + hotfix during beta.
Natalie (legal): We'll need NDA + DPA signed before any data leaves customer network. For Private on-prem we still want a minimal template for audit logs. Legal sign-off required before onboarding starts for each partner.
Ben (solutions): Practical ask: add an observability hook that exposes per-route token counts, cache hit rates, and a small trace id in responses for partner triage (can be opt-in). That will reduce debug churn.
Anna (product): Good, thanks. For quality gate: propose model-regression <1.5% on our DP evaluation suite (no hallucination spike, core intents pass). Also ask partners to run 5 canonical prompts and provide transcripts.
Raj (eng): On model-regression, we should define the eval harness and thresholds per model size. I'll add automatic diffing and an alert if any metric degrades >0.5% from baseline during rollout.
Emily (design): Can we add a quick partner UX checklist? e.g., sample prompts, expected output shapes, fallback messaging for timeouts. Keeps feedback consistent.
Omar (cs): Also capture success metrics from partners: weekly usage, % of sessions with expected response, and NPS for beta features after 2 weeks.
Anna (product): Deployment policy: start with 2 seeded partners in week 1, expand to 6 in week 3 if gates hold. rollback policy: if any critical regression or repeated infra errors across >=2 partners within 24h -> pause cohort.
Natalie (legal): Agree. For data residency gating, require a signed statement of permitted data types and a mapping of logs we can receive. If there's customer PII risk, we need a data-processing addendum before proceeding.
Raj (eng): Implementation note for infra: add automatic KV-cache warmup for partner-specific prefixes to avoid cold-start spikes. Also include a per-partner rate limiter that we can tune without redeploy.
Ben (solutions): Incentives: offer 3 months free Dedicated credits + implementation support for partners who finish onboarding and provide 5 feedback sessions. That seemed to work last time.
Emily (design): We should standardize the feedback session script so evals are comparable across partners. I'll draft a short 20-min script: walk through 5 tasks, ask for failure modes, observe confusion points.
Anna (product): Ownership — Raj owns perf gate, Natalie owns legal gate, Omar owns support runbook, Emily owns feedback script, Ben owns partner incentives. Product will batch final sign-offs.
Raj (eng): Timeline check: can we have perf harness + alerts by EOD next Wed? I can prioritize if we drop a lower-priority infra task.
Anna (product): Yep, prioritize it. I'll update the beta plan doc and the recruitment invite template.
oncall-bot: Summary created: "private/dedicated beta gating checklist" — doc link: https://redwood.example/internal/beta-gating (auto) :white_check_mark:
Anna (product): Thanks all — will circulate sign-off matrix and onboarding checklist tomorrow. Please add any constraints in thread. :thumbsup:
